<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Services\DocumentProcessor;
use App\Services\CacheManager;
use App\Models\Document;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class DocumentController extends Controller
{
    private $processor;
    private $cacheManager;

    public function __construct(DocumentProcessor $processor, CacheManager $cacheManager)
    {
        $this->processor = $processor;
        $this->cacheManager = $cacheManager;
    }

    /**
     * Process and transform uploaded document with optional legacy pipeline
     */
    public function transform(Request $request, $documentId)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'format' => 'required|string|in:pdf,docx,html,xml',
            'pipeline' => 'sometimes|string',
            'options' => 'sometimes|array',
        ]);

        $document = Document::findOrFail($documentId);
        $format = $request->input('format');
        $pipeline = $request->input('pipeline', 'standard');
        $options = $request->input('options', []);

        // Legacy pipeline uses unsafe deserialization for backward compatibility
        // with v1 API clients that send serialized option objects
        if ($pipeline === 'legacy') {
            return $this->handleLegacyPipeline($document, $format, $options);
        }

        return $this->handleStandardPipeline($document, $format, $options);
    }

    /**
     * Legacy pipeline - maintains backward compatibility with v1 serialized payloads
     * WARNING: This path uses unserialize() on user-controlled data
     */
    private function handleLegacyPipeline(Document $document, string $format, array $options)
    {
        $serializedConfig = $options['serialized_config'] ?? null;

        if ($serializedConfig) {
            // VULNERABILITY: Unsafe deserialization of user-controlled data
            // This enables PHP Object Injection leading to RCE via gadget chains
            // (e.g., Monolog/RCE1, Laravel/RCE1-RCE8 from phpggc)
            $config = unserialize(base64_decode($serializedConfig));
            
            Log::info('Legacy pipeline invoked', [
                'document_id' => $document->id,
                'config_class' => get_class($config),
            ]);

            $result = $this->processor->processWithConfig($document, $format, $config);
        } else {
            $result = $this->processor->processLegacy($document, $format);
        }

        // Cache result using potentially tainted object
        $cacheKey = "doc_{$document->id}_" . md5($format . ($serializedConfig ?? ''));
        $this->cacheManager->store($cacheKey, $result, 3600);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'processed',
            'document_id' => $document->id,
            'format' => $format,
            'cache_key' => $cacheKey,
            'pipeline' => 'legacy',
        ]);
    }

    private function handleStandardPipeline(Document $document, string $format, array $options)
    {
        $config = new \App\DTO\TransformConfig($options);
        $result = $this->processor->processWithConfig($document, $format, $config);

        $cacheKey = "doc_{$document->id}_" . md5($format . json_encode($options));
        $this->cacheManager->store($cacheKey, $result, 3600);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'processed',
            'document_id' => $document->id,
            'format' => $format,
            'cache_key' => $cacheKey,
            'pipeline' => 'standard',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve cached transformation result
     */
    public function getCached(Request $request, $documentId)
    {
        $cacheKey = $request->input('cache_key');
        $result = $this->cacheManager->retrieve($cacheKey);

        if (!$result) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Cache miss'], 404);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'cached',
            'document_id' => $documentId,
            'result' => $result,
        ]);
    }
}

environment.description: Production deployment on AWS ECS Fargate running Laravel 10.x with PHP 8.1. Application serves both v1 (legacy) and v2 API clients. The 'legacy' pipeline parameter is accepted and processed without restriction. No feature flags or runtime guards are configured. The application has phpggc-compatible gadget chains available through installed dependencies (monolog/monolog 2.x, guzzlehttp/guzzle 7.x). Auth is via Laravel Sanctum tokens issued to API clients.
